visual.titulo: Impact of MNCs on host countries
visual.veredicto: It depends on laws, behaviour and reinvestment

turnos.t: Are multinationals good or bad for host countries?
Both. On the plus side: direct and indirect jobs, foreign direct investment, tax revenue, and technology and skills that stay even if the company leaves. Wages are often above the local average.

Profits are often repatriated to the home country. Local firms can be crowded out. Where laws are weak, they may pollute. So the impact depends on regulation, on how the company behaves, and on whether profits are reinvested locally.
